strategy.offer: Custom medical devices, materials, care products, equipment, digital manufacturing solutions, and related services and training for laboratory and clinical workflows.
strategy.customers: Dental laboratories, clinical practices, hearing-care retailers, and end users, served through specialist trade channels in many international markets.
strategy.why_we_win: It expects to win through continuous innovation, early adoption of digital production, reliable quality, process precision, and personal service.
strategy.resources: Its base is skilled custom-device manufacturing, in-house research and development, motivated employees, certified quality systems, and international production and distribution capabilities.
strategy.direction: The company is moving toward broader digital manufacturing and sustained organic international growth while continuing to launch innovative quality products.
